## Description

Formulates portfolio risk factor covariance matrix factorization into Binary Quadratic Optimization problems solved via quantum annealers to isolate latent risk drivers during market crashes.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional risk management, systemic crisis stress testing, institutional risk parity allocation.

## Vehicles

Risk-Parity Funds, Institutional Quantitative Risk Groups.

## Required data

Historical asset return covariance matrices, factor exposure panels, stress test parameters.

## Caveats

NISQ hardware qubit embedding heuristics are required for large sparse factor matrices.
